sentence: This project tries to find out which genomic features and molecular mechanisms decide the host ranges of insect-specific and mosquito/vertebrate flaviviruses.
This project studies rare craniosynostosis syndromes and aims to advance care for patients with these diseases.
This project uses machine learning to build a model that predicts neurological injury in patients supported by extracorporeal membrane oxygenation.
This project improves air quality models to find the origin of pollutants and studies how they relate to cardiorespiratory health events in western cities.
This project builds open-source informatics tools to organize and curate skin images and data so that skin cancer detection can improve.
This project studies the biological basis of human cancer and builds tools to improve cancer diagnosis, therapy and prevention.
This project studies how viruses replicate and cause disease, including the human immunodeficiency virus and herpes viruses, and looks at antiviral compounds and vaccines.
This project tries to find out how astrovirus enters and leaves goblet cells, which produce mucus in the small intestine.
This project develops sequencing methods to detect drug-resistant tuberculosis early so patients can get appropriate treatment.
This project studies how the transcription factor that drives glioblastoma stem cells is controlled, aiming to halt tumor growth and overcome therapy resistance.
This project studies how airway stem cells change in transplanted lungs and how that leads to chronic lung allograft dysfunction.
This project builds a research center that develops therapies for muscular dystrophy beyond microdystrophin gene therapy.
This project studies how proteins secreted by neural stem cells affect the function and behavior of the adult hippocampus.
This project builds tools that combine chemistry and deep learning to identify glycan-protein interactions and work out their structures.
This project tests compounds in a patient-derived 3D tumoroid model of clinically non-functioning pituitary tumors to find ones that kill or slow tumor growth.
This project measures hospitalization and mortality caused by tropical cyclones and studies physical factors that make the impacts differ between communities.
This project studies how lipid droplets and lipid metabolism affect skeletal muscle satellite cells, which repair muscle after injury.
This project builds stem cell models of morphogenesis to test developmental toxicity, aiming to reduce and replace live animal toxicity tests.
This project studies how a regulatory component of CRISPR-transposase systems controls programmed DNA-insertion at the molecular level.
This project tests what limits human stem cell derived retinal organoids as models for studying retina disease and testing gene therapy.
